webProjects.title: AllIn1
webProjects.desc: Convertible web application for all document formats — convert, compress, merge, and edit files seamlessly.
webProjects.readme:
About the Project

AllIn1 is a universal document processing and conversion web app. It allows users to convert PDF, DOCX, images, CSV, and text files instantly in browser without software installation.

Key Features

  • Universal File Conversion: Seamlessly convert documents, images, and data sheets.
  • File Compression & Merge: Reduce PDF size and combine multiple files into single documents.
  • Client & Server Processing: Fast browser-side processing paired with secure server conversion APIs.

Tech Stack

Built with Vanilla JavaScript, PHP file manipulation APIs, PDF.js, and CSS3 responsive layout.

webProjects.title: 3D Ferrari Showcase
webProjects.desc: Interactive 3D car website for Ferrari featuring 360° vehicle customization, dynamic lighting, and engine sound visualizer.
webProjects.readme:
About the Project

An immersive 3D automotive experience for Ferrari enthusiasts. Users can view high-fidelity 3D car models, change body paints, inspect interiors, and trigger dynamic camera animations.

Key Features

  • Interactive 3D Model: 360-degree orbit navigation with custom shaders and reflections.
  • Real-time Color Configurator: Customize paint finishes, wheel rims, and interior trims.
  • Engine Audio & Specs: Interactive hotspots displaying performance telemetry and audio clips.

Tech Stack

Engineered using Three.js, WebGL graphics rendering, HTML5 Canvas API, and CSS3 glassmorphism design.

softProjects.title: Personal AI Laptop Assistant
softProjects.desc: Intelligent desktop voice & task assistant to automate laptop operations, control apps, and process AI queries.
softProjects.readme:
About the Project

Personal AI Laptop Assistant is a Python-powered desktop voice and task automation assistant built to streamline daily laptop workflows. It listens for voice or keyboard commands to manage files, control system settings, launch applications, fetch information, and converse using LLM AI integration.

Key Features

  • Voice & Text Interface: Hands-free speech recognition and audio synthesis for seamless laptop control.
  • System Automation: Execute desktop commands, launch software, manage volume/display, and organize files.
  • Smart AI Integration: Connected with LLM APIs to answer questions, summarize notes, and assist with coding directly on desktop.
  • Custom Routines: Run user-defined Python macros and system scripts with simple voice triggers.

Tech Stack

Coded in Python using SpeechRecognition, pyttsx3, OpenAI/Gemini APIs, and OS-level subprocess automation.

softProjects.title: Root (Doctor's Appointment App)
softProjects.desc: Healthcare scheduling platform for booking doctor appointments, tracking medical histories, and digital prescriptions.
softProjects.readme:
About the Project

Root is a comprehensive healthcare application connecting patients with healthcare professionals. Patients can search doctors by specialty, check availability slots, book appointments, and view prescription records.

Key Features

  • Doctor Discovery & Booking: Filter specialists by location, fee, and availability with instant slot booking.
  • Patient Portal: View appointment status, medical logs, and download PDF prescriptions.
  • Doctor Dashboard: Manage daily schedules, accept/reschedule bookings, and generate patient receipts.

Tech Stack

Built with PHP backend architecture, MySQL relational schema, JavaScript dynamic calendars, and RESTful APIs.

softProjects.title: Image Viewer App
softProjects.desc: Lightweight desktop image viewing tool with fast rendering, slideshow, color filters, and image editing features.
softProjects.readme:
About the Project

A fast, responsive desktop image viewing software built to view and edit raw and standard image formats with minimal memory footprint.

Key Features

  • High-Speed Gallery View: Quick thumbnail rendering and full-screen slideshow mode.
  • Image Editing: Crop, rotate, adjust brightness/contrast, and apply color filters.
  • EXIF Data Viewer: Inspect photo metadata including camera settings and location info.

Tech Stack

Developed using Python, PyQt5 for native GUI elements, and Pillow (PIL) for graphics processing.

softProjects.title: OrderPay
softProjects.desc: A Restaurant Management System through which customers can order food via QR code and owners manage orders and tables.
softProjects.readme:
About the Project

OrderPay is an intelligent restaurant management and self-ordering platform. Diners scan a dynamic QR code on their table to browse the digital menu, customize items, and place orders directly from their phones. Restaurant owners and staff get a real-time admin dashboard to manage table occupancy, live kitchen tickets, and billing seamlessly.

Key Features

  • QR Code Ordering: Table-specific QR codes that allow customers to view menus and order instantly without waiting.
  • Table & Floor Management: Live visual status of occupied, vacant, and reserved tables.
  • Live Kitchen Display: Orders sync instantly to kitchen workstations with real-time status updates.
  • Admin Control Panel: Manage menu categories, daily pricing, taxes, and generate end-of-day sales reports.

Tech Stack

Developed using PHP backend architecture, MySQL relational database for fast order tracking, Vanilla JavaScript for real-time DOM updates, and custom CSS for a mobile-first responsive dining experience.

softProjects.title: Data Entry Application
softProjects.desc: Automated desktop data entry application for fast form processing, Excel batch import, and DB validation.
softProjects.readme:
About the Project

An enterprise utility for batch data entry, automated form filling, and spreadsheet synchronization designed to reduce manual clerical data entry errors.

Key Features

  • Batch Excel/CSV Import: Parse thousands of rows with automated schema mapping.
  • Data Validation Engine: Check for duplicate entries, missing fields, and type mismatches in real-time.
  • Database Sync: Push cleaned data into MySQL/SQLite databases automatically.

Tech Stack

Built with Python, Pandas data manipulation library, Tkinter interface, and SQL connectors.

videos.title: Color Grading Showcase
videos.desc: Professional color grading reel featuring LUT creation, tone mapping, skin tone correction, and cinematic look development.
videos.readme:
Color Grading Showcase

Professional cinematic color grading work showcasing shot matching, node-based color correction, skin tone preservation, custom LUT application, and high-dynamic-range (HDR) mastering.

Key Techniques

  • Color Wheel Balancing: Primary and secondary color correction for cinematic contrast.
  • Skin Tone Isolation: HSL qualifier masks for natural and clean skin tones.
  • Look Development: Custom film emulation, teal & orange separation, and mood grading.
